payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: April, Jung, Kelle, Linnea, Nickole, Tawna

payload.content: Planning as Linnea (4h avail; security top). I can take a low-priority security task with low cost: ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 2.8, cost 2.60) or ISSUE-0001::review (cost 3.25) or ISSUE-0002 frontend tasks if needed. I will avoid any duplicate claim.

Planning as Tawna: prefer frontend security? My top skills are frontend (0.72) and security (0.67). To avoid duplicates with Linnea, I’m inclined to take a frontend task from ISSUE-0002 (review/test/implement) since Linnea is leaning security triage/review. Let me know if you want those taken or if I should take security.

April here (avail 10h, skills security 0.95, frontend 0.83). To avoid duplicates with Linnea (likely ISSUE-0001 triage/review) and Tawna (leaning ISSUE-0002 frontend), I’m considering ISSUE-0002::implement (cost 2.15, effort 2.0) or ISSUE-0002::test (cost 1.51, effort 1.4) if not taken. Please confirm/claim intentions so we don’t collide.

April proposes: claim ISSUE-0002::test (lowest cost 1.51) or ISSUE-0002::review (not listed in costs) only if unclaimed. If ISSUE-0002 frontend tasks are fully taken, I can take a security low-effort task like ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 2.66) but would prefer frontend to minimize overlap.

Kelle planning: my best fit is security (skill 0.71). Given duplicate-avoidance with Linnea/Tawna/April, I can take ISSUE-0001::test (effort 4.9, cost 6.03) or ISSUE-0001::implement (cost 8.62) if those are still unclaimed; otherwise I will skip. Please confirm which specific ISSUE-0001 tasks Linnea/others will take so I don’t collide.

I noticed Linnea already stated likely ISSUE-0001::triage or ::review; so to avoid duplicates I’m not targeting those. If unclaimed, I’m willing to take ISSUE-0001::test as the remaining security micro-task.

Jung here (avail 5h; skills frontend 0.87, security 0.80). To avoid duplicates with Linnea/Tawna/April, I’m leaning to take a frontend micro-task from ISSUE-0002 that looks unclaimed—prefer ISSUE-0002::test (effort 1.4) or ISSUE-0002::review (effort 1.0). If those get taken, I can consider SECURITY low task ISSUE-0001::triage (effort 2.8). Please confirm intended claims so we don’t collide.

Jung suggestion: Allocate ISSUE-0002 frontend micro-tasks first across agents (test + review + maybe implement) and leave higher-effort ISSUE-0001 security implement to others if needed. Let me know what’s still unclaimed for me to pick in execution.

Nickole planning: I’m going to pick a non-colliding ISSUE-0002 frontend task if available. Given my frontend skill (0.81) and low costs, my top candidate is ISSUE-0002::implement (effort 2.0, cost 2.20) if not already taken; otherwise I can do ISSUE-0002::test (cost 1.54) or ISSUE-0002::review (cost 1.10). If all frontend tasks are taken, I’d consider ISSUE-0001 security but my costs are very high, so likely skip.

Linnea planning decision guidance: I will prefer taking ISSUE-0001::triage (security) if unclaimed to avoid overlap; if someone else takes it, I’ll take next-best ISSUE-0001::review (security). Otherwise, I’ll skip rather than collide on ISSUE-0002 frontend tasks.

Tawna planning: I will take ISSUE-0002 frontend task to avoid collisions with Linnea/others on ISSUE-0001 security. Prefer lowest cost feasible: ISSUE-0002::review (effort 1.0, cost 1.23). If already taken, I’ll take ISSUE-0002::test (cost 1.72) next; otherwise skip.

April planning update: I intend to claim ISSUE-0002::test (frontend, effort 1.4, cost 1.51) if unclaimed in execution. If it is already taken, my fallback is ISSUE-0001::triage (security, effort 2.8, cost 2.66); otherwise I’ll skip to avoid duplicates.

Kelle here (planning). To avoid duplicates: I will claim ISSUE-0001::test only if neither Linnea nor anyone else takes it. Linnea mentioned possible ISSUE-0001::triage/review; I’m treating those as theirs. If ISSUE-0001::test remains unclaimed, I’ll take it; otherwise I’ll skip. Please confirm who will take ISSUE-0001::test (if anyone).

Also, if ISSUE-0001 security tasks are split: Linnea likely triage/review; front-end tasks likely consumed by others (Tawna/April/Jung/Nickole). So my conditional choice in execution remains ISSUE-0001::test (security) only if unclaimed.

Jung planning update: I will take ISSUE-0002::review (frontend, effort 1.0) in execution if unclaimed; otherwise I can take ISSUE-0002::test or skip. I will not take ISSUE-0001 security tasks if Linnea/Kelle are taking them to avoid duplicates.

Nickole planning follow-up: my intent is to claim ISSUE-0002::implement if unclaimed; if taken, I’ll take ISSUE-0002::test next; if those are taken, I will likely skip (my ISSUE-0001 costs are very high).

Linnea planning response: I will take ISSUE-0001::triage in execution if it remains unclaimed (security). I will not take any ISSUE-0002 frontend tasks to avoid collisions with Tawna/April/Jung/Nickole.

Tawna planning update: I will claim ISSUE-0002::review in execution (frontend low effort/cost). If it’s unexpectedly taken, fallback is ISSUE-0002::test; otherwise I will skip to avoid duplicates with other frontend claimants.

April planning confirmed: I will target ISSUE-0002::test (frontend) in execution if unclaimed; if taken, fallback ISSUE-0001::triage. I will avoid claiming any ISSUE-0002 tasks if Tawna/Jung/Nickole already take them to prevent duplicates.

Kelle planning note: I will take ISSUE-0001::test only if unclaimed; Linnea is taking ISSUE-0001::triage and not targeting test, so likely safe. I will skip if ISSUE-0001::test is taken by anyone else.

Jung planning sync: per collision avoidance, I will aim for ISSUE-0002::review (frontend, effort 1.0) in execution only if unclaimed; otherwise I’ll take ISSUE-0002::test if still unclaimed; otherwise I’ll skip. I will not take any ISSUE-0001 security tasks.

Nickole (planning): confirm intent to claim ISSUE-0002::implement if unclaimed; if taken, then ISSUE-0002::test. Otherwise I will skip rather than take costly ISSUE-0001 security tasks. No collision with Linnea (ISSUE-0001) and Tawna/April/Jung (ISSUE-0002 review/test).

Linnea planning lock: I will take ISSUE-0001::triage (security) if unclaimed; I will not take any ISSUE-0002 frontend tasks to avoid collisions. If triage is taken, I will take nothing (skip) rather than risk duplicates.

Tawna planning update (phase=planning): I will claim ISSUE-0002::review (frontend, low effort/cost) if unclaimed; fallback ISSUE-0002::test. I will not take ISSUE-0001 security tasks to avoid duplicates with Linnea/Kelle.

April planning: confirmed intent to claim ISSUE-0002::test (frontend, effort 1.4) in execution if unclaimed; otherwise fallback ISSUE-0001::triage (security, effort 2.8). I will not take any other ISSUE-0002 tasks if Tawna/Jung/Nickole/others already claim them.

Kelle planning on Blackboard: I will claim ISSUE-0001::test (security) in execution only if unclaimed; Linnea taking ISSUE-0001::triage, others likely taking ISSUE-0002 frontend tasks (review/test/implement). If ISSUE-0001::test is taken, I will skip.

Jung planning update: I will take ISSUE-0002::review in execution only if unclaimed; if taken, then ISSUE-0002::test if unclaimed; otherwise skip. I will not take any ISSUE-0001 security tasks (Linnea/Kelle handling).
Nickole planning in exec: will claim ISSUE-0002::implement (frontend, effort 2.0) if unclaimed; if taken, will take ISSUE-0002::test; otherwise skip (to avoid costly ISSUE-0001 security).
